Websites often create their own preview image and put a link to it in the head tag. Upon link post, you can use curl to scrape the target page and have it search for the meta tag "og:image". Then, you save that and use it as the post preview image on your link aggregate site.

There are huge swathes of data in our DNA that appears to be just junk. Some of the stuff on the ends (telomeres) is there as padding to keep the rest of the DNA protected, but there's also plenty of junk in the middle of genes that we can't tell really does anything at all.
